daily.title: Coal’s share in India’s power generation hits six-month high at 70.16% amid El Niño
daily.summary: Coal's share in India's power generation rose to 70.16% in October as El Niño hit renewable output and higher non-solar demand boosted thermal power reliance. The share of coal in India’s power generation rose to its highest level in the last six months as the El Niño effect impacted hydropower and renewable energy generation amid high demand during non-solar hours.
